note: Every path adopt seeds into a project by copying its bytes, tracked in the manifest. A project gets the loop as well as the rules: .claude/skills/ and .claude/commands/ carry pick-work and /work, and docs/roles/ carries one guide per role. An entry ending in / expands to every file under it, so a file landing on another branch joins this list when it lands. The bin/ entries are named one by one because bin/adopt is this template's own tool and does not belong in a project it seeded. CLAUDE.md is absent because a project's router is rendered from adopt's answers rather than copied: this repository's copy describes agentkit, and a project's carries its own name, summary and open questions. .github/workflows/ is absent for a second reason: a tracked file is replaced on every rerun and the project's version moves to a .local sidecar, and GitHub runs no .local, so a project that had tuned its workflow would silently be running this repository's copy. adopt renders both workflows from the pack and seeds them once.
